name: ibis budget Singapore Ametrine
short_description: A 2-star budget hotel on Lorong 10 Geylang, a 10-minute walk from Aljunied MRT and minutes from Kallang MRT and the Singapore Sports Hub.
ai_summary: ibis budget Singapore Ametrine sits at 10 Lorong 10 Geylang, in vibrant Geylang, about a 10-minute walk from Aljunied MRT Station and minutes from Kallang MRT and the Singapore Sports Hub. The economy hotel offers compact rooms (around 12 sqm) with flat-screen TVs, tea/coffee facilities, and free WiFi, though it has no on-site restaurant. Expedia lists a 7.0/10 guest score from 131 reviews, and guest feedback consistently highlights sparkling-clean rooms, brand-new bedding and bathroom amenities, and friendly staff, with occasional notes about a lack of early check-in flexibility. Two confirmed YouTube reviews -- from WowHotelReviews and HotelKDM -- corroborate the small, clean, budget-tier room layout. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme's points or elite-tier benefits.

faqs.question: Is ibis budget Singapore Ametrine part of the ALL loyalty programme?
faqs.answer: No -- despite the ibis budget/Accor branding, this hotel's own Accor listing confirms it does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, so members cannot earn or redeem points or elite benefits here, though ALL member rates may still apply.

faqs.question: How far is ibis budget Singapore Ametrine from Aljunied MRT station?
faqs.answer: It's about a 10-minute walk from Aljunied MRT Station, with Kallang MRT and the Singapore Sports Hub just minutes away. The Central Business District is roughly a 10-minute drive, and Orchard Road is about 15 minutes away by car.
